requirements.text: 验证复用必须覆盖本次风险与检查集合，并校验控制面身份和准入前置条件。
需求完成态必须逐通配分支拒绝缺失的必填内容。
Git 交付必须绑定实际仓库，拒绝未逐引用验证的隐式标签推送。
Explicit applicability must be honest, narrow, conflict-free and bound to the current verification contract across all consumers.
Upgrade proof must inspect the actual remote commit and propagate missing proof instead of reporting PASS.

design.summary: Bind reuse to requested verification scope and configured identities; retain missing wildcard branches; reject Git execution contexts and implicit refs that lack matching evidence.
